title: Bến cảng lặng
about: Round x19 (album 14), the user: "làm album và chuyển sang sáng tác album mới": sleep music in the style of Sleep in the Dark (ngu-ngon), on a less common progression of its own (template 3), slow (48 bpm), waves, pad, sub, choir, an improvised solo tune, then glass. No drums, plucked string or organ. An original piece.
